clauses.clause: Player remains visible through camera-side fences, walls, hordes and corpses by cut/dither/silhouette.
clauses.note: Both actual low/high quality, fire engine/wall/canopy at actual zoom0.5/1.5:12 focused views after physical KeyD12ticks. Courier-only mask retains ≥0.9305556 share and ≥1047visible pixels; zero fully hidden cases. Reviewed L1–L6 ordinary physical route frames also show courier foreground silhouette through fences, walls, shield crowds and corpse piles. L2 amber silhouette counts as visible; transport ride hiding is scripted interior presentation. Later-level route observations are retained in the final campaign manifests. No rule weakened to demand a large unoccluded body.
